devdoc.details: Pure internal ID architecture for arbitration Key Design Principle: - Contract ONLY uses internal dispute IDs (localDisputeId) for all logic - External IDs (talentId, gigId, etc.) are stored as metadata in the struct - Frontend tracks externalId → localDisputeId mapping via events - No on-chain mappings from external IDs to internal IDs

Dispute(address,uint256,uint256,uint256).details: To be emitted when a dispute is created to link the correct meta-evidence to the disputeID.

params._disputeID: ID of the dispute in the Arbitrator contract.
params._evidenceGroupID: Unique identifier of the evidence group that is linked to this dispute.

Evidence(address,uint256,address,string).details: To be raised when evidence is submitted. Should point to the resource (evidences are not to be stored on chain due to gas considerations).

params._evidenceGroupID: Unique identifier of the evidence group the evidence belongs to.
params._party: The address of the party submiting the evidence. Note that 0x0 refers to evidence not submitted by any party.

MetaEvidence(uint256,string).details: To be emitted when meta-evidence is submitted.

Ruling(address,uint256,uint256).details: To be raised when a ruling is given.

params._disputeID: ID of the dispute in the Arbitrator contract.

concedeDispute(uint256,uint256).details: Conceede dispute in favor of the other party

params._localDisputeId: The internal dispute ID (from createDispute or events)

createAndPayGigDisputeByClient(uint256,a.details: Convenience: Create dispute and pay fee in one transaction (Gig - Client)

createAndPayGigDisputeByFreelancer(uint2.details: Convenience: Create dispute and pay fee in one transaction (Gig - Freelancer)

createDispute(uint256,uint256,uint8,byte.details: Create a new dispute Returns the localDisputeId which must be used for all subsequent operations

returns.localDisputeId: The internal dispute ID to use for all operations

fundAppeal(address,uint256,uint8).details: Fund an appeal. Can be called by anyone (crowdfunding).

getAppealCost(uint256,uint256).details: Get the arbitration cost for a new dispute or the appeal cost for the current round depending on the side

params._localDisputeId: The internal dispute ID (from createDispute or events)

getCurrentRuling(uint256).details: Get the current ruling of a dispute

params._localDisputeId: The internal dispute ID (from createDispute or events)

getDisputeStatus(uint256).details: Get the current status of a dispute

params._localDisputeId: The internal dispute ID (from createDispute or events)

hasTimedOut(uint256).details: Check if a dispute fee payment has timed out

params._localDisputeId: The internal dispute ID (from createDispute or events)

rule(uint256,uint256).details: Give a ruling for a dispute. Called by the arbitrator.

startAndPayTalentDisputeByClient(uint256.details: Convenience: Create dispute and pay fee in one transaction (Talent - Client)
